# @stapel/brick-react 0.3.0

Stapel 4-bit brick games: a tiny fixed-step engine (seeded RNG, input queue, grid model) with Tetris/Snake/Arkanoid/Racing/Tanks/Memory as pure modules, a <BrickConsole> LCD skin drawn in DS tokens with a phone keypad, local high scores, and a <WaitingGame> host helper for the seconds a person spends waiting.

No backend Django module of its own — this is the 4-bit BRICK GAME console: a fixed-step engine (seeded RNG, input queue, grid model) with six games as pure modules, a token-drawn LCD skin with a phone keypad, local high scores through core's createRepository, and the <WaitingGame> helper a host drops into the seconds someone spends waiting.

## Analytics events (typed; defineEvent → events.json, drift-gated)
- (no app defineEvent() in this pair — its analytic events are the
  auto-instrumented flow funnels below)

## Flow funnels (auto-instrumented: flow.<id>.<step> {phase})

```tsx
// Typed event + tracked() click (the one right way; §3.1).
const planSelected = defineEvent({
  name: "pricing.plan.selected",
  description: "User picked a plan",
  props: { plan: prop.oneOf(["free", "pro", "team"], "Plan code") },
});
const { tracked } = useTracked();
<Button onClick={tracked(planSelected, { plan }, startCheckout)} />
// A click that STEPS a flow machine is already instrumented — mark it
// data-analytics="flow" instead; tracked() on top double-counts (§3.2).
```

## Demos (defineDemo → manifest.demos; compiled, linted, rendered examples)
- brick.console → <BrickConsole> [default|snake|arkanoid|racing|tanks|memory|menu|level|phone]  demo/BrickConsole.demo.tsx
- brick.waiting → <WaitingGame> [default|processing|done]  demo/WaitingGame.demo.tsx
Each source file is the canonical usage snippet (open the default variant).

## Snippets
```tsx
// One-provider setup (StapelConfigProvider + QueryClientProvider + I18nProvider).
const client = createStapelClient({ baseUrl, getAccessToken });
<StapelProvider client={client} queryClient={queryClient} i18n={i18n}>
  <App />
</StapelProvider>
```
```tsx
// Error narrowing — never a cast (stapel/no-raw-error-shape).
if (isStapelApiError(err)) return <Alert>{t(err.code, err.params)}</Alert>;
```
